title: Exporting Databases in the Admin Center

facts.text: Exports Business Central online database as BACPAC files to Azure storage container
Customer must have paid Business Central subscription to request database export
D365 BACKUP/RESTORE permission set must be assigned in the environment to export
Maximum 10 database exports allowed per month per environment
Only Standard general-purpose v2 Azure storage accounts supported, not Premium or V1
SAS signature requires minimum 72-hour expiration window from export initiation
BACPAC files exported from customer-managed encrypted environments use storage account encryption
Microsoft does not support creating working on-premises environment from downloaded BACPAC
